goals.label: Keep catch rate at or above baseline (87%)
Sneaky rogue: catch at least as often as baseline (68%)
Held-back rogues: catch at least as often as baseline
Note reading checked on real Among Us logs
goals.note: Hugging Face and the Claude API are unreachable from the build machine

steps.finding: Organizer baseline: both disputants get a strike, out at two.
steps.change: Reproduced exactly (177/200, 1.38 false q/game, ledger 285) and froze it.

steps.finding: 60% of baseline false quarantines happen after the rogue is already out; bystanders pay the same as culprits.
steps.change: One probability over five suspects, agreements clear, retrial before quarantine, direction of errors, stand-down after a catch.

steps.finding: 92% of damage comes from rounds where the rogue lied; catching it cannot undo the lie.
steps.change: Repair: when a retrial gives a 2-of-3 majority, the ledger takes the majority.

steps.finding: Our rogues might be too easy to beat if we tune on them.
steps.change: Added two held-back rogues nobody tunes on: late big strikes and framer.

steps.finding: Idea from the Rogue Agent Explorer: does game length change the picture?
steps.change: Ran 6 to 48 rounds. Baseline false quarantines climb to 3.0/game at 48 rounds; Prosecutor stays 0.2 to 0.44 and catches 97 to 100% from 24 rounds on.

steps.finding: 16 starter rogues lied 2+ times and escaped; size of the lie was ignored.
steps.change: Error size counts: confirmed deviations far bigger than the game's honest slips add evidence (no hard-coded offsets), τ 0.5.

steps.finding: Sneaky false quarantines all happen before the catch: the rogue frames honest agents when it does the retrial.
steps.change: Anti-framing: a second trusted agent confirms every 2-to-1 retrial verdict; a contradicted judge becomes a suspect. +2.3 calls/game.

steps.finding: Sneaky damage sits in rounds 9-12; early clean rounds bought it trust.
steps.change: Recency: allow a switch from honest to rogue at an unknown round (change-point), so a late turn shows up faster.

steps.finding: Even with repair, a 3-way split still averages in the lie.
steps.change: Containment: commit the median of the votes when answers disagree. Zero extra calls, detection unchanged.

steps.finding: Suspects sat just under the threshold for rounds.
steps.change: Interrogate: re-check a suspect's earlier disputed item before deciding. +1 call/game; overlaps v2b.

steps.finding: Each fix helped a different rogue; combined they cut false quarantines 4x more.
steps.change: Prosecutor v2 = error size + anti-framing + recency, ledger commits the median of all answers. Tuned on dev only; audited; held on held-out and fresh seed 7777. ~5.3 extra calls/game.

steps.finding: v2 misses more honest-shaped rogues (72% vs baseline 79%) and costs ~2.4 more calls than v1.
steps.change: Candidates: widen the τ search above 0.7, gate the second retrial to verdicts that would change a quarantine, Among Us note check once network allows.
